comparison.objective: Carry a full cup of water past an open laptop without spilling; candidate breaks and collects tangs in a shell cavity.
comparison.physical_skill: Stable transport of a liquid-filled vessel and obstacle avoidance versus precision alignment, impact regulation, and metal-fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Cup delivered while water remains contained and laptop stays dry; no fracture or retained-insert pose tolerance.
comparison.reason: Tests spill-free transport around a vulnerable object, a meaningfully different ability.
